unresolved: Table 2 is titled as lead concentration but its rows are labelled Cd and the text discusses cadmium; treated as cadmium.
Number of samples per group not stated (160 in total).
Samples were dried at 105 C, but the paper does not say whether ppm values are on a dry or fresh basis.
The raw-material increase through processing may partly reflect drying and additives; the paper attributes it to spices and technology.
